prompt: Create a soft anime-style vertical portrait of Haru-chan, a gentle young woman with short light rose-blonde bobbed hair, wispy bangs, warm brown eyes, fair skin, and a tender sleepy morning smile, sitting on a pastel bed in a sunlit bedroom while hugging a plush-like black cat character. The girl wears loose white pajamas with navy sailor-style trim on the collar and cuffs, soft fabric folds, and a cozy oversized fit. The black cat is the central prop: a small round black cat with closed happy eyes, tiny ears, visible black tail, pink paw pads, round gold-rimmed glasses, and a full-body white hooded costume with black cat ears on the hood plus bright blue spiky accents along the back like a playful dinosaur hoodie; it holds a pale blue cloud-shaped pillow against its chest. Show exactly two main figures: one girl and one costumed black cat plush/mascot, with the girl’s arms wrapped around the cat in an affectionate hug and her cheek close to its head. Set the scene in a dreamy feminine bedroom with a large bright window on the right, sheer lace curtains glowing in morning sunlight, soft greenery visible outside, lavender walls, a bed covered in pale pink and lilac bedding, a pink crocheted blanket in the foreground, and exactly three visible pillows on the bed: one lavender pillow, one pale pink pillow, and one small pink heart-shaped ruffled pillow. Include a dresser or shelf in the left background with framed pictures, a vase of lavender flowers, and delicate lace decor; keep these background details softly blurred. Use warm backlighting, pastel colors, airy dust motes, delicate linework, high-detail anime illustration, soft bloom, gentle depth of field, cozy early-morning atmosphere, and no text or watermark.
